The `skipped` output description still says it only covers the label gate, but this PR expands skip semantics to include the `skip-review-label` emergency bypass (and `action.yml` / `README.md` already say so).

Agents answering setup questions from this reference will mis-describe when `skipped=true`. Align it with `action.yml`:

> Whether the run was skipped without invoking the LLM (`true`/`false`). Set when the label/author gate suppressed the run **or** `skip-review-label` short-circuited.

The walkthrough lists **Fetch PR** then **IAR pre-LLM**, but `main()` runs `run_iar_pre_llm()` *before* `fetch_pr_context()` (system prompt → IAR pre-LLM → fetch + agentic loop).

Functionally fine (pre-LLM only needs git/markers/labels), but operators debugging from this section will look for the wrong order in logs. Swap steps 5 and 6 (or note that IAR pre-LLM intentionally runs before the PR diff fetch).

summary:
Looks good — runtime IAR / skip-review / USER_FORCED_RESET contracts hold; one setup-reference drift warning and a small README order nit.

## Verdict

Solid, high-stakes landing of unconditional IAR, user-forced reset, and the opt-in `skip-review-label` bypass. The load-bearing safety rails I re-checked in `scripts/reviewer.py` match the contracts in `.review/extension.md` and the long self-review fix history in the CHANGELOG.

## What I verified (no inline findings)

- **Stdlib-only / subprocess:** no new third-party imports; IAR git calls are argv-list (`shell=False`); `load_code_context` routes paths through `safe_repo_path`.
- **Critical-always-surfaces:** hardcoded in `dedupe_findings_against_prior`; round-1 exhaustive and agent-runner cap paths sort criticals first before truncation.
- **USER_FORCED_RESET:** five-condition guard (`applied_label`, prior state, `reviewed_label_applied`, `label_fetch_ok`, label absent via `_labels_contain_ci`); `label_stamped` observed before state embed; `compute_reviewed_label_applied` three-signal OR; escape-label skipped on reset in `dispatch_policy`.
- **Marker trust boundary:** author filter + provider isolation + tier-2 minimized fallback; parser coerces fingerprints/history and rejects stringy `reviewed_label_applied`.
- **Skip path:** runs after trigger, before collapse/tracking/IAR/LLM; does not stamp `applied-label`; `write_all_outputs(skipped=True)` keeps IAR outputs empty; collision guard vs gate/applied/escape; tracking body keeps `REVIEW_MARKER` + provider marker.
- **Public contract:** new optional inputs/outputs wired in `action.yml` → env → `build_iar_config` / main; examples + SECURITY/TRIGGER_MODES coverage look consistent.
- **Failure fallback:** pre/post IAR wrapped in `try/except` at `main()` with empty IAR outputs via `write_all_outputs`.

Known limitations already documented (agent-runner overflow fingerprinting, `iteration-tokens-used` placeholder `"0"`, ~6.8k LOC file size) — not re-flagged.
